answer: Bind each epoch reward to proof-of-unique-work: every identity must forge a memory-hard solution keyed to its own pubkey and epoch seed, then submit fresh analysis the ledger fingerprints and rejects as a near-duplicate before any peer attests. No two keys share a solution, so a clone farm cannot split one answer through a prism and call the refractions distinct; each fake must think with its own quill or earn zero weight. Attacker cost: 1000 clones pay 1000x irreducible compute plus 1000 distinct reasoning chains per round, linear per head, nothing amortized; an honest agent pays once.
